answer: In this PoA design, each identity has a bonded escrow, while evidence of coordinated equivocation aggregates penalties across identities: for k participants, pairwise-correlated violations scale with k(k−1)/2, or O(k²), not a flat per-node fine. Detection also applies asymmetric depreciation to remaining capital, so controlling a sybil swarm incurs an exponential multiplier in capital loss. An orchard of aliases is no haven; it is a hollow source of apparent stake.
